about: Real sizes in metres ([min, usual, max]) and contact points of the 2D library (format: docs/2d-library/05-world-sizes-prompt.md). From the Brief 5 delivery (sources: notes/world-sizes-SOURCES.md), adopted by scripts/world-data-check.mjs. Wall parts' contacts are heights above the floor. engine/cartoon/world.js reads it.

sit.ikRule: pelvis drops to contacts.seat.y; knees bend to ~90 deg with feet planted at y=0 (or step.y); spine leans back if contacts.seatBack exists

lie.ikRule: body rotates horizontal along contacts.bed.y; head rests at contacts.pillow.y (+0.08 m above mattress)

stand on.ikRule: character ground y-offset shifts up to contacts.top.y or contacts.step.y

under.ikRule: character stands or sits within contacts.roofUnder.x range; headTop must remain below contacts.roofUnder.y (or character ducks if clearance < 0)

in.ikRule: character passes through contacts.door.x (if height < door.height) or submerges to contacts.waterline.y

lean.ikRule: elbow or shoulder rests against target contact at y = 0.85–1.10 m, spine tilts 8–15 deg toward contact

hold.ikRule: prop origin (0,0) snaps to active hand socket; if grip='two', second hand snaps to grip2 offset

carry.ikRule: sustained transport during walk cycle; hangs below hand for bail handles (bucket, tiffinCarrier), rests on hip for kolshi, or rests at headTop for basketOnHead

wear.ikRule: attaches to headTop (prayerCap, basketOnHead), eye bridge (glasses), or neck/shoulders (stethoscope, medal, idCard, schoolBagHeld)

give.ikRule: ZC.handover interpolates prop (0,0) from giver hand to receiver hand at midpoint chest height (y = 1.05–1.15 m)

open.ikRule: hand reaches contacts.doorHandle.y (1.00 m) or contacts.handle.y and pulls/pushes arc

close.ikRule: hand reaches contacts.doorHandle.y or contacts.handle.y and returns shutter/leaf to closed state

push.ikRule: both hands plant on contacts.handle.y (0.85–1.05 m) with forward torso lean (15–22 deg)

pull.ikRule: hand grips handle/rope and leans backward (-12 deg) while drawing toward torso

ride.ikRule: pelvis locks to contacts.passengerSeat.y or contacts.rider.y and inherits vehicle/animal world translation and bob

drive.ikRule: pelvis locks to contacts.driverSeat.y and hands IK-target contacts.handle.y (steering wheel, handlebars, or oar)

get in.ikRule: foot steps onto contacts.step.y (0.28–0.55 m), head ducks below contacts.door.height or roofUnder.y, then transitions to passengerSeat/driverSeat

get out.ikRule: rises from seat, ducks below door/roofUnder, steps down via contacts.step.y to y=0 ground

climb.ikRule: alternating hand-and-foot vertical progression along step.y riser increments (0.15 m stairs or ladder rungs)

pat.ikRule: hand reaches animal contacts.head.y or contacts.back.y with gentle vertical oscillation (+/- 0.03 m)

lead.ikRule: person walks 0.8–1.2 m ahead of animal with hand holding tether linked to animal contacts.neck.y

feed.ikRule: hand extends food prop to animal contacts.mouth.y or scatters grain toward ground/waterline

milk.ikRule: person squats or sits on low piri (y=0.15 m) beside cow/goat flank with bucket at y=0 and hands at udder height (y=0.45 m)

drink.ikRule: hand lifts vessel so contacts.rim.y meets character mouth (eyeHeight - 0.11 m) with 25–40 deg tilt

eat.ikRule: right hand cycles between plate/bowl (contacts.top.y) and character mouth; for animals, head lowers to ground (act='eat')

write.ikRule: pen/chalk tip tracks across contacts.top.y (desk at 0.72–0.75 m) or vertical blackboard (0.85–1.85 m)

read.ikRule: gaze vector locks onto book/paper/screen held 0.30–0.45 m in front of eyes or resting on desk top

cook.ikRule: hands operate utensils at stove/chula contacts.top.y (0.36 m seated for mud chula; 0.96 m standing for gasStove)

wash.ikRule: hands held under contacts.spout.y (tubewell 0.52 m, washBasin 0.88 m, kitchenSink 1.02 m) or dipped at pond waterline

putDown.ikRule: hand lowers prop so prop contacts.base.y aligns with target surface contacts.top.y or shelf.y, then releases grip

pickUp.ikRule: if target y < 0.55 m, character bends knees/waist; hand reaches prop contacts.grip.y and attaches prop to hand

look at.ikRule: head pitch and gaze angle orient toward target centre or contacts.screen.y

pray.ikRule: standing (qiyam), bowing (ruku), kneeling/sitting (tashahhud on prayerMat y=0.01 m), or raising hands in dua (munajat at chest height) / anjali mudra

sweep.ikRule: for short Bangladeshi jharu (0.65 m), spine bends forward 30–40 deg while right hand swings broom in lateral arcs across y=0

row.ikRule: boatman (majhi) seated or standing at stern (y=0.65 m) cycles boatOar (boitha) blade through waterline (y=0.35 m)

pump.ikRule: hand grips tubewell lever at contacts.handle.y (0.85 m) and cycles vertically between y=0.55 m and y=1.05 m

pour.ikRule: tilts kettle/waterJug 45–65 deg so contacts.spout aligns 0.08–0.18 m above target cup/glass contacts.rim

point.ikRule: arm extends toward target contact (blackboard, sign, horizon, or item) at shoulder-to-eye elevation

knock.ikRule: hand raises to chest/shoulder height (y=1.25–1.40 m) on door/gate leaf and oscillates forward 3 times

water.ikRule: tilts watering can, mug, or hose at y=0.60–0.90 m above flowerBed, plant, or crop rows

harvest.ikRule: squats to cut paddy stalks at y=0.15–0.35 m with sickle (kaste), or reaches y=0.95 m for tea leaves / y=1.80 m for fruit

thresh.ikRule: beats paddy bundles onto slanted wooden pataton or operates pedal threshing drum (pedal at y=0.35 m, drum top at y=0.75 m)

grind.ikRule: seated on floor/piri (y=0.10 m), pushes cylindrical stone roller (puta) back and forth across flat shil stone at y=0.12 m

fan.ikRule: rotates wrist +/- 25 deg at chest/face height (y=1.10–1.35 m) holding handFan (haat pakha)

play.ikRule: operates musical instrument (harmonium keys/bellows, ektara string, bambooFlute, dhol/tabla) or sport item (football, cricketBat, marbles)

talk.ikRule: face-to-face conversational gesturing or holding mobilePhone/microphone/megaphone near mouth/ear

wave.ikRule: hand or held flag/handkerchief raised above shoulder height (y=1.45–1.80 m) oscillating side-to-side

bow.ikRule: respectful Bangladeshi greeting (salam raising right hand to forehead, namaskar palms together, or touching an elder's feet in kadambusi)

hug.ikRule: two-person embrace (such as Eid kola-kuli) or hugging a child/pet at chest/shoulder height

none.ikRule: ambient or distant background piece requiring no direct physical contact

animalActMechanics.idle: Gentle continuous breathing, ear flicks, tail swish, or eye blink driven purely by t.
animalActMechanics.walk: Four-phase articulated leg cycle (or two-leg waddle/hop) with planted hooves/paws that do not slide on the ground.
animalActMechanics.run: Fast bounding/galloping stride with higher leg lift, longer stride reach, and forward body pitch.
animalActMechanics.eat: Neck and head lowered to ground/trough (y=0.05–0.25 m) with rhythmic jaw chewing or grazing motion.
animalActMechanics.drink: Head lowered to water surface (y=0.0–0.15 m) with rhythmic lapping or gulping.
animalActMechanics.sleep: Body lowered onto ground (legs tucked under belly, head resting down or curled, slow deep breathing).
animalActMechanics.sit: Hindquarters lowered to ground while forelegs remain upright (typical for streetDog, cat, monkey, lion, tiger).
animalActMechanics.perch: Bird resting on branch, wire, or ledge with micro balance sway and head turns.
animalActMechanics.peck: Bird pitching body and neck rapidly downward to strike grain or insects on the ground/branch.
animalActMechanics.fly: Continuous wing flapping cycle; anchor y represents sky altitude and flocks move in formation.
animalActMechanics.glide: Wings outstretched horizontally with gentle banking tilt and altitude undulation.
animalActMechanics.swim: Floating at contacts.waterline.y with paddling feet below and concentric water ripples expanding around body.
animalActMechanics.wade: Submerged up to chest or back (contacts.waterline.y) in river/pond water with surface ripples.
animalActMechanics.jump: Parabolic leap arc above ground or water surface (frog, rabbit, fishInPond, dolphin, goat).
animalActMechanics.call: Vocalization pose: rooster crowing with neck stretched, dog barking, cuckoo/doel singing, frog vocal sac pulsing, or tiger roaring.
animalActMechanics.groom: Bird preening wing feathers with beak, or cat/dog scratching/licking paw.
